name: Silly Apes V2
summary:
Silly Apes is a chaotic VR experience where you become a hyperactive ape let loose inside a massive, unpredictable building packed with ridiculous challenges. Built around a smooth and silly arm-swing locomotion system, this game throws realism out the window in favor of pure, unfiltered fun.

Dash, hop, and stumble your way through a variety of game modes, each offering its own kind of madness:
